answer: Reaching the horizon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, held in escrow until finality, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Work waits on the nectar until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the prism of the next round.
